snippet.title: Our Life: Now & Forever Trailer
snippet.description:
A paper airplane, two new neighbors, four autumns, and a one of a kind life. Create an experience that’s all your own in this near-fully customizable, choice-heavy story where you grow from childhood to adulthood. Our Life: Now & Forever is a visual novel in development by GB Patch Games.

Kickstarter: https://gbpatch.com/olnfkickstarter
Steam: https://gbpatch.com/ourlife2steam
Itch.io: https://gbpatch.com/ourlife2itch
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/gbpatch
Twitter: https://twitter.com/patch_games
Tumblr: https://gb-patch.tumblr.com/
Discord: https://discord.gg/Q9YvQx2

Trailer created by axeleraey!
